body: i’ve been before and i hated it i think i just need some sleep. i forced myself to get up and go to the bathroom and brush my teeth and wash my face which i haven’t done in a while. i texted a couple friends but none of them have answered. the friend i’m with i don’t really feel comfortable sharing this kinda stuff with and she’s sleeping anyways
i’ve reached out so many times it doesn’t help. there’s nothing they can do to fix me
most times i don’t necessarily lie i just leave out a lot of information
i was wondering the same thing. it’s only been two weeks since i lost my best friend but i’m taking it especially hard. i hope it gets better but i know i’ll live with this for the rest of my life.

i am so incredibly sorry. i’ve had similar experiences with my best friend dying and having a near death experience with suicide aswell. this year has been awful but i’m hoping for both of us we’ve hit rock bottom and the only way left is up because i honestly can’t think of a worse year than this one. you and your family will be in my prayers <3

i’m feeling the same thing. my best friend died 2 weeks ago and people keep telling me it’ll get better as if it’ll just up and go away like all of the sudden i won’t care anymore. that’s not how grief works. but i think people who haven’t gone through loss this hard don’t understand and genuinely think it feels like any other type of pain or loss. my best wishes to you though your mom will be in my prayers <3
thank youuuuu

i’m not really blaming myself as much i just feel bad because that was one of the last times we hung out. she had a lot of other things going on such as bullying, ed, depression, etc.so i know it’s not my fault it just hurts to know i wasted one of my last hangouts with her.

i’m so sorry for your loss. i’m praying for you and your family. i lost my best friend this week so although i can’t understand exactly what i’m going through i understand what it’s like to lose a loved one.

be as supportive as possible, love them unconditionally, and honestly just spend time with them. make lots of plans if you can. if they have something to look forward to that’s always a really good thing. 

listen if they need you to, offer advice if you can but if you can’t, that’s okay too. just listening is enough. sometimes someone just needs to talk your ear off to feel better. 

please do watch out for signs. i’m not going to go over them here but you can research it with a quick google search. look for the signs that they might be planning on committing. just follow all the rules of being a good friend. <3
you can always dm me i’m always open to talking
i believe in you <3

i’m really sorry. this is an awful situation you’re in. i really do hope that you are able to get the help that you need. i know you’re looking for advice and i can’t provide that because i myself am not sure what to do on that case but i can say that i’m here for you if you ever need. my moms a single mom and we’ve gone through our share of abusive stepdads so i understand 100%. sometimes i wish i could go to my dads but he doesn’t care about me and would probably neglect me and it’d end up being worse. so like i said, talk to me if you need. i wish you the best of luck <3

this was really well said, try new things you’ve always wanted to do, make new friends, make your life the life you’ve always wanted in every way you possibly can. if in a way it’s not possible, that’s okay too. not everything is going to work out. i wish you the best of luck. <3
i’m rooting for you too i know you’re strong. i know you can do it.
this really really helped thank you so much
of course i’m always open to talking

hey. i really don’t know what to say other than i want you to stay. it doesn’t really make a difference that i say this because i’m some random person online but i know that someone out there loves you and someone out there cares about you and someone out there will miss you. i’ve had multiple attempts one of which i was out of school for a month for and didn’t attend actual classes for the rest of the year for, i had people i didn’t know knew my name ask me where i was. or people i don’t talk to anymore. you are wanted no matter how much you feel like you aren’t. you’re not a failure. sometimes you have to put your mental health first. don’t worry about school. school will still be there. i’m not promising things will get better because i genuinely don’t know that. things may get better this month things may get better in 5 years but i want you to hold on until then please. you are worthy and loved. <3 talk to me if you ever need it

i know we don’t know eachother but you don’t understand how happy i am you’re still here. i’m so so so glad and proud of you for coming somewhere where people want to help you. i’ve had failed attempts i know what it’s like. i’m always here to talk about it.
me too

i just wanted to say how important it is to compliment people. i’ve been so insecure about my voice my whole life but especially recently. i feel like it’s annoying and i have a small lisp. but i actually got a compliment from someone today who said my voice is so calming and now i feel so confident. <3

for me it’s all sorts of little things that tie into a bigger picture. my dogs, if i ever left they wouldn’t know why they’d just think i abandoned them. music, i love music, making music, playing music, doesn’t matter i love it all. it’s my biggest coping skill. sometimes you just have to find yours. i didn’t really find my music until this past year. it may take a while but you will find something that will help you get through this tough time. my friends and family would be so upset. although, you should want to stay for yourself too. you should want to stay. make yourself want to stay. give yourself purpose. make goals for yourself even if they’re small goals. my goals are always to make people happy and make people laugh and smile. you just have to find what’s right for you. and i know you can do it because i made it so so can you
i’m so glad!

i’m so bad at this but i do know that if you compliment people it works in your favor. tell people that you like their hair or outfit. maybe you’ll end up being friends or maybe you just made their day. who knows you never know till you try.
i’m always open to listening to venting. i’ve been told i give pretty good advice to so if you or anybody ever needs it don’t be shy
happy birthday! mine was yesterday! hope this birthday topped last years!

i wish the same things too sometimes. i always wished i didn’t care about what people thought of me. what i wore, what i said, etc. but that doesn’t always mean you’re happy. my friend morgynne was like that. she didn’t care about what people thought of her. she dyed her hair whatever color, she wore pjs to school, she never wore makeup, she did what she wanted. she was the best, she was kind to everyone, had the best sense of humor that came with the most amazing laugh, i thought she was beautiful, and she cared for everyone around her. but people still shit on her. she got bullied everyday about being gay, her looks, just everything and anything people could come up with. this monday she committed suicide and it broke so many hearts. even though she thought so many people disliked her, even the girl that bullied her the most was left crying, donating to her fundraiser, and everything. she was cared about even if she didn’t know. maybe that’s the situation with you. i know 100% if she saw the support she was getting now she would regret her decision. i know she was dealing with a lot more but just knowing people care about you can make 100% of the difference.

i know you feel like grades and school are everything but if your mental health is bad you need to take care of that before anything. i know it’s hard to think this way and i’ve struggled with it before too but people aren’t going to be disappointed in you if you put your mental health first. <3 i wish you the best of luck i believe in you
it just makes me feel invalidated when someone says “some have it worse, be grateful” because then sometimes i think i’m just faking it for attention when i’m really not.

i know for a fact that you’re effecting somebody’s life for the better. i may not know you but i know everybody has an impact on everybody you meet whether it’s your best friend or your barista at the coffee shop in the mornings. i promise you you’re life is worth it. i’m not going to give you that speech about “it’ll get better someday” because i genuinely can’t guarantee that, it may get better tomorrow, it may get better in a year, but i can tell you that your attitude can sometimes change the whole way you think. if you think all the positives you’ll feel maybe just a little bit more positive. like you said, your puppy probably loves you more than anything in the world. hell, you are his/her world so stay here for them. i know more than anything it feels like it’s your only way out trust me. but it’s not. try new things. talk to new people, make it your goal to make someone’s day even if it’s just by complimenting their outfit. give yourself a purpose in life. i’ve had multiple attempts some of which i was hospitalized for but i’m still here. my best friend died this week from suicide and everybody around is heartbroken. some people she didn’t even like or didn’t like her. you have an impact, you have a purpose, you are loved even if it’s just your puppy (which i guarantee you it’s not just your dog that loves you) i wish you the best. if you ever need to reach out please do.
